question: Does recover work while the card with recover is on the battlefield?

expected.shortAnswer: No: recover is a triggered ability that functions only while the card is in a graveyard.
expected.answer: 702.59a Recover is a triggered ability that functions only while the card with recover is in a player’s graveyard. “Recover [cost]” means “When a creature is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, you may pay [cost]. If you do, return this card from your graveyard to your hand. Otherwise, exile this card.”

whyHard: Most abilities work from the battlefield, and recover is an unusual one that works from the graveyard.
